Dear [Sir](../persons.html#2370)
The lines are certainly not mine - nor do I think I could ever have quoted them for I do not remember ever to have heard them[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Envelope addressed to J B [or R?] Scarlett Esq/ 24 Cramer Terrace/ Gateshead on Tyne, postmarked 87.

[^2]: CMY\'s correspondent, an accountant who is listed at this address in the 1891 census, used the same trick to get autographs from both Thomas Hardy and A. C.

Swinburne: see Collected Letters of Thomas Hardy, VII, 105 and The Swinburne Letters, V, 231.
